sys_di_key.description:
Analyze the document and locate the section titled "5(D) RATIOS". In this section, find the row labeled "Working Capital Turnover". Extract the value corresponding to the latest available financial year and calculate Net WCC Days using the formula:
Net WCC Days = 365 / Working Capital Turnover
Rules: 1. Look only inside the "5(D) RATIOS" section. 2. Extract the latest available financial year value for "Working Capital Turnover". 3. Calculate: Net WCC Days = 365 ÷ Working Capital Turnover 4. Return only the calculated numeric result. 5. Round the result to 2 decimal places. 6. If the Working Capital Turnover value is "-", blank, 0, or missing, return "NA". 7. Do not extract or calculate using: - Current Ratio - Quick Ratio - Receivables Days - Inventory Days 8. Output must contain only the calculated value.
sys_di_key.name: Net WCC Days
